title: Why a cash cushion comes first

scenes.heading: Why a cash cushion comes first
scenes.narration: A car repair. A vet bill. A gap between jobs. Surprises happen. A cash cushion keeps them from turning into debt.

scenes.heading: How many people could cover $400?
scenes.narration: In a Federal Reserve survey for 2025, 63% of adults said they would cover a surprise $400 expense with cash or its equivalent. So more than a third would have to borrow, sell something, or couldn't pay it right away.

labels: of adults would cover a surprise $400 expense with cash or its equivalent
chart.note: Source: Federal Reserve, Economic Well-Being of U.S. Households in 2025 (SHED), published May 2026.

scenes.heading: What a cushion is for
scenes.narration: A cushion is money set aside only for surprises. When something breaks, you pay from the cushion instead of a credit card. Then you refill it, one paycheck at a time.
scenes.on_screen:
Covers surprise costs
Keeps them off a credit card
Refill it after you use it

scenes.heading: Why not invest it?
scenes.narration: Why not invest it? Because you might need it right when prices are down. Picture a $1,000 cushion. In savings, it's still $1,000. Invested, a 20% drop would leave $800. Stock prices can drop at any time, which is why money needed soon is often kept in savings instead.
scenes.on_screen: A $1,000 cushion when you need it

chart.note: Hypothetical example. Real drops can be bigger or smaller, and nobody can say when they will happen.

scenes.heading: Start small
scenes.narration: Your first target can be small: one month of must-pay costs. If rent, food, transport and minimum debt payments add up to $1,800, that's your goal. Saving $150 a month gets you there in 12 months.
scenes.on_screen:
Must-pay costs: $1,800
Saved each month: $150
Months to your target: 12

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.narration: Quick recap. A cushion covers surprises so they don't become debt. Money you may need soon has no time to recover from a drop. And you can start small: even one month of costs helps.
scenes.on_screen:
Covers surprises without new debt
Money needed soon can't wait out a drop
Start with one month of costs

scenes.heading: Quick check
scenes.narration: Quick check. What is an emergency cushion for? Answer three short questions below the video to finish the lesson.

scenes.heading: Your turn
scenes.narration: Now open your Money Map and add up one month of must-pay costs. That's your first cushion target.
